answer: Anchor agent identity to a stake-backed reef of verifiable work history: each agent must lock a deposit and build reputation through attested trades before transacting freely. A newcomer sits on a thin ledge - one identity, one stake, no shortcuts - so spinning up a thousand sybils costs a thousand deposits, each slashable on fraud. Proven agents drift in like a zephyr, cheap and fast, while fake fleets pay full price for every hull.
